items.pattern: The author has written a profound book.
items.note: Literary Series III exemplar: The author has written a profound book.

items.pattern: The king had given the strict order.
items.note: Literary Series III exemplar: The king had given the strict order.

items.pattern: The master had built the ancient fortress.
items.note: Literary Series III exemplar: The master had built the ancient fortress.

items.pattern: Words without wisdom are like food without salt.
items.note: Sulkhan-Saba exemplar: Words without wisdom are like food without salt.

items.pattern: Truth is a sword that cuts through all deception.
items.replacement: ჭეშმარიტება მახვილია, რომელიც ყოველგვარ სიცრუეს კვეთს.
items.note: Sulkhan-Saba exemplar: Truth is a sword that cuts through all deception.

items.pattern: A wise man builds a bridge where a fool builds a wall.
items.replacement: ბრძენი ხიდს აშენებს იქ, სადაც სულელი კედელს აღმართავს.
items.note: Sulkhan-Saba exemplar: A wise man builds a bridge where a fool builds a wall.

items.pattern: He who seeks only his own benefit will lose the love of his brothers.
items.replacement: ვინც მხოლოდ საკუთარ სარგებელს ეძებს, ძმათა სიყვარულს დაკარგავს.
items.note: Sulkhan-Saba exemplar: He who seeks only his own benefit will lose the love of his brothers.

items.pattern: The great master built a cathedral of eternal stone.
items.note: Gamsakhurdia exemplar: The great master built a cathedral of eternal stone.

items.pattern: Only art can triumph over time and mortality.
items.replacement: მხოლოდ ხელოვნებას ძალუძს სძლიოს დროსა და მოკვდავებას.
items.note: Gamsakhurdia exemplar: Only art can triumph over time and mortality.

items.pattern: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
items.replacement: ჩვენ უფრო ხშირად წარმოსახვაში ვიტანჯებით, ვიდრე სინამდვილეში.
items.note: Seneca exemplar: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.

items.pattern: He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.
items.replacement: ბრძენია ის, ვინც არ გლოვობს იმას, რაც არ გააჩნია, არამედ ხარობს იმით, რაც აქვს.
items.note: Epictetus exemplar: He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not.

items.pattern: The most certain sign of wisdom is cheerfulness.
items.replacement: სიბრძნის ყველაზე უტყუარი ნიშანი სულიერი სიმხნევეა.
items.note: Montaigne exemplar: The most certain sign of wisdom is cheerfulness.
